name: Lantern Quake
a: A round paper lantern glowing electric yellow hangs at the top of the frame, then drops straight down and smashes on grey moon rock at the bottom centre with a flash.
b: A burst of yellow sparks and grey moon dust thrown outward in a ring
snd: a glass lantern dropping and smashing with an electric pop and a dusty thud

name: Glowtrail
a: A glowing snail trail seen from above at a slant, as a wide ellipse: a spiral of bright green-yellow slime on dark ground with small sparks running round it, slowly turning.
b: A column of green-yellow sparks and small glowing lichen flakes bursting straight up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame
snd: a wet fizzing sizzle spreading, then a crackling burst of sparks

name: Low-Gravity Stomp
a: A big round grey moon boulder seen falling straight down: the boulder at the bottom centre of the frame, with pale dust and wind streaks streaming straight up behind it to the top of the frame.
b: A slow wide ring of grey moon dust with pebbles floating upward
snd: a long descending whistle, then a soft heavy thump with dust hissing

name: Shell Flare
a: A spiral snail shell made of white-gold light with a bright orange flame burning inside it, spinning in place.
b: A burst of white-gold light and orange flame in a spiral
snd: a bright flare igniting with a rising shimmer and a fiery puff

name: Crater Claw
a: Two huge crab claws of dark rock with glowing violet-orange cracks reach in from the left and right edges of the frame and snap shut together in the centre. Only the claws, no body.
b: A burst of dark rock shards with violet-orange embers
snd: two great stone claws snapping shut with a deep crack and a hiss

name: Moss Leap
a: A small tuft of green moss and tiny white flowers rolled into a ball, spinning in a puff of pale wind.
b: A small burst of green moss flecks, white petals and wind streaks
snd: three soft bouncy hops in a row, each with a leafy puff

name: Caldera
a: A grey moon crater at the bottom centre of the frame fills with glowing orange lava and erupts, throwing a column of lava and hot rock up to the top of the frame.
b: A burst of glowing lava drops and grey rock chunks
snd: a deep rumble building into a lava eruption with a roar

name: Spark Hop
a: A small ball of yellow lightning with two long wind streaks curling behind it like ears, bouncing in place.
b: A small electric pop: a burst of yellow sparks with a puff of wind
snd: three quick springy electric zaps one after another

name: Ray Crater
a: A crater ring at the bottom centre of the frame; bright orange and yellow rays of fire and lightning shoot down into it from the top edge, and it flares.
b: A star-shaped burst of orange fire and yellow lightning rays
snd: a fierce beam striking down with a crackling fiery blast

name: Afterburner
a: A small comet of orange and blue jet flame with a round glowing head, burning hard, flickering in place.
b: A fiery burst with curling wind streaks and orange embers
snd: a jet of flame roaring past, then a hot whooshing burst

name: Lichen Halo
a: A ring of pale golden light with tiny glowing lichen flakes along it starts wide at the edges of the frame and shrinks inward until it closes on the centre with a soft flash.
b: A soft burst of golden light with drifting pale green lichen flakes
snd: a gentle rising hum closing in, then a soft bright chime

name: Hollow Shell
a: A dark spiral seen from above at a slant, as a wide ellipse: a snail-shell spiral of black-violet stone turning slowly round a pitch black centre, with thin violet glow lines.
b: A column of dark violet smoke and grey stone flakes rising straight up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame
snd: a low hollow drone circling down, then a dark breathy rush

name: Geode Gust
a: A split grey geode, its inside lined with bright lilac crystals, spinning in place in a swirl of pale wind.
b: A burst of lilac crystal shards carried outward on wind streaks
snd: a sharp gust of wind with tinkling crystals, then a glassy burst

name: Phase Horns
a: Two curved ibex horns of blue-white ice start at the left and right edges of the frame as thin crescents and grow inward until they meet in the centre as one full ring.
b: A burst of ice shards and pale blue frost in a ring
snd: ice creaking as it grows, then two horns clacking together with a cold ring

name: String of Fire
a: A string of round moonstone beads glowing orange-hot, curled into a ring and turning in place, with small flames on each bead.
b: A burst of glowing orange beads and flame scattering outward
snd: beads rattling fast like a chain, then a fiery snap

name: New Moon Cut
a: A thin crescent blade of pale silver wind spinning in place like a boomerang, with a few grey stone flecks.
b: A burst of two crossed silver slash marks with grey stone chips
snd: two sharp blades slicing the air in quick succession with a stony chip

name: Druse Spark
a: A cluster of bright yellow crystals seen falling straight down: the cluster at the bottom centre of the frame, with yellow lightning streaming straight up behind it to the top of the frame.
b: A burst of yellow lightning arcs with crystal shards
snd: a crackling bolt falling, then a sharp crystalline electric crack

name: Full Geode
a: A plain grey moon rock in the centre cracks open along bright seams of golden-white light, wider and wider, until it stands fully open and blazing with crystals.
b: A burst of golden-white light with crystal shards and grey rock chips
snd: stone cracking open slowly, then a bright ringing burst of crystal

name: Dark Side
a: A dark moon with a thin bright violet rim descends from the top of the frame to the bottom centre, its shadow falling ahead of it.
b: A burst of violet light round a black disc, with grey dust
snd: a deep slow descending tone, then a muffled heavy boom

name: Mochi Pound
a: A big wooden mallet swings down from the top of the frame onto a soft white rice cake at the bottom centre, which squashes and glows orange-hot.
b: A burst of soft white rice cake blobs, green leaf flecks and orange embers
snd: a wooden mallet thumping down on something soft and sticky, with a sizzle

name: Diving Bell
a: A big clear bubble of air with blue water rippling round it starts wide at the edges of the frame and shrinks inward until it closes tight on the centre.
b: A burst of water droplets and small air bubbles with grey pebbles
snd: a bubble squeezing shut underwater with a deep gulp and a pop

name: False Dawn
a: A small sun of white-gold light rises from the bottom centre of the frame to the top, growing as it climbs, with orange flames licking round its edge.
b: A burst of white-gold sunrays with orange flame
snd: a warm swelling roar of light rising, bright and brassy

name: Ice Knight
a: A lance of blue-white ice with a thin stream of water spiralling round it thrusts straight down from the top of the frame to the bottom centre.
b: A burst of ice shards and cold water spray
snd: a spear of ice driving down with a sharp crack and a splash

name: Garden Crater
a: A moon crater seen from above at a slant, as a wide ellipse, filled with green moss, small white flowers and glowing yellow lantern lights, slowly turning.
b: A fountain of green leaves, white petals and yellow glowing motes bursting straight up from the bottom centre to the top of the frame
snd: soft rustling growth and tiny bells, then a leafy bursting rush

name: Wyrm Circuit
a: A chain of round beads joined by crackling yellow lightning, curled into a ring and turning in place, each bead glowing orange.
b: A burst of yellow lightning and orange sparks in a ring
snd: electricity running fast along a chain, then a snapping crack

name: Moonflower
a: A pale flower of white-gold light grows from the bottom centre of the frame on a green stem and opens its petals wide at the top, shedding glowing pollen.
b: A burst of white-gold petals and soft green leaves
snd: a soft rising chime as a flower opens, with a gentle shimmer

name: Night Mallet
a: A heavy black mallet with a glowing violet band swings down from the top of the frame to the bottom centre, trailing dark purple smoke.
b: A burst of dark purple smoke with violet sparks and green leaf flecks
snd: a heavy dark mallet whooshing down and landing with a dull, echoing thud

name: Ember Spiral
a: A spiral of glowing orange beads and small green leaves winding round a bright flame, turning in place.
b: A burst of orange flame, glowing beads and burning leaves
snd: a crackling fire spinning past, then a bright fiery pop

name: Bubble Stream
a: A clear shining bubble with a little swirl of blue water inside, wobbling in place, with a wisp of pale wind.
b: A small pop: a ring of water droplets and wind streaks
snd: three soft bubbly pops in a row with a breath of wind

name: Wide-Eyed Dark
a: Two huge round eyes glowing violet open in the dark at the left and right of the frame, then drift together and merge into one black disc with a violet ring in the centre, like an eclipse.
b: A burst of violet light round a black disc, with grey stone flakes
snd: an eerie rising whine, then a deep hollow thump

name: Lamp Tide
a: A fountain of blue water rises from the bottom centre to the top of the frame, carrying glowing yellow lantern lights up with it on curling wind.
b: A burst of water droplets, yellow lights and wind streaks
snd: water rushing up in a fountain with small glassy chimes

name: Eclipse Crab
a: A black disc with a blazing violet-orange corona seen falling straight down: the disc at the bottom centre of the frame, with violet and orange flames streaming straight up behind it to the top of the frame.
b: A burst of violet-orange fire round a black disc, with dark rock shards
snd: a dark fireball falling with a low roar and a heavy crunching impact

name: Sickle Dawn
a: A crescent blade of white-gold light spinning in place like a boomerang, with a short flame along its edge.
b: A burst of two crossed white-gold slash marks with wind streaks
snd: two bright blades of light slicing past with a clean ringing shing

name: Sickle Dusk
a: A crescent blade of black with a thin bright violet edge spinning in place like a boomerang, trailing dark smoke.
b: A burst of two crossed violet slash marks with dark smoke
snd: two dark blades slicing past with a low hiss and a cut

name: Moons of Its Own
a: A little full moon of pale gold with a calm sleeping face, glowing softly, slowly turning in place with one tiny moon orbiting it.
b: A small burst of pale gold light with grey moon dust
snd: three soft deep chimes in a row, each with a dusty thud
